ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the length of line segment AB is 24 cm. AB is extended to C such that BC is equal to $\frac{1}{2}$ of AB. What is the length of AC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $BC = \frac{1}{2}AB$ and $AB = 24$ cm, \\
then $BC = \frac{1}{2} \times 24 = 12\, \text{cm}$, \\
therefore $AC = AB + BC = \boxed{36}\, \text{cm}$.
